textType: Welcome to React Bits! Good to see you!

about.label: Who am I
about.title: About Me
about.desc: Hi, I'm Wahyu, a graduate of vocational high school majoring in Software Engineering. I have a strong interest in IT, specifically in Backend Development & Web Development.

project.label: What I've built
project.title: My Projects
project.desc: Every project is a space to turn ideas into real solutions and sharpen skills with each line of code.

items.name: Student Attendance
items.deskrip: An application to help teachers record and export student attendance in Excel format.

items.name: POS System
items.deskrip: A POS application to record item stock, sales data, supplier restock data, and customer member data.

items.name: Online Shoe Store
items.deskrip: An online shoe store application that allows customers to easily search, select, and order their favorite shoes. With a modern and responsive design, it delivers a comfortable and fast shopping experience.

items.name: Tokopedia Clone
items.deskrip: A Tokopedia clone application built with React and Tailwind.

items.name: Instagram Clone
items.deskrip: A mobile version of Instagram clone using React and Tailwind as FE, Laravel as BE, and PostgreSQL as the database with shadcn UI components.

journey.label: My journey
journey.title: My Journey
journey.desc: Every step is a process of continuous growth and building work that matters.

items.title: The Beginning of Learning to Code
points: Started exploring coding self-taught after graduating junior high.
Got curious about how websites work and learned HTML and CSS on my own.
Turned this interest into the reason I chose the RPL major.

items.title: Graduate of Software Engineering
points: Dived into web programming, databases, and algorithm logic.
Studied PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript at school.
Graduated by building a student attendance app as the competency exam.

items.title: Building a Student Attendance App
points: Built a student attendance app with Laravel for the graduation competency exam.
Teachers log in, scan a QR code in each classroom, and are taken straight to that class's attendance page.
Provided an attendance data export feature for teachers and school records.
Completed the project from scratch to a working app.

items.title: Sharpening Skills as a Web Developer
points: Diving deeper into modern web development with React and Next.js.
Getting used to solving problems and debugging independently.
Interested in learning new programming languages like Go.
Continuously building projects to strengthen my portfolio.

items.title: Looking for My First Work Experience
points: Open to internship, junior, or project collaboration opportunities.
Ready to learn, take feedback, and grow within a team.
Used to working in teams from school assignments and projects.
Eager to apply what I've learned to real-world projects.

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.title: Contact Me
contact.desc: Still learning, but serious with every line of code I write. Open to opportunities as a fullstack developer, project collaborations, or internship slots in a supportive team.
